lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 vertical white lines visible; spacing is non-uniform, with wider gaps (~15-20% of torso width) at the center and tighter clustering toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the anterior and mid-sections show fragmentation, appearing as 2-3 distinct vertical segments rather than continuous lines from the dorsal to ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Approximately 5 distinct white spots are visible on the lateral surface of the upper hind limb, arranged in a loose triangular formation.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower haunch align to form a semi-diagonal geometric vector pointing towards the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Left horn exhibits a spiral lyrate trajectory, initially diverging laterally at roughly 35 degrees from the sagittal plane before curving inward and upward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: 0.85; the distance between the apical tips is slightly less than the combined width of both horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 10% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking across the bridge of the nose and two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/mandible region.
